description: Pull rows from a CMS dataset by datasetId (UUID from search_datasets). Returns an array of row objects whose keys are the dataset columns. Supports paging (size/offset), full-text keyword search across the dataset, and exact-match column filters via filters: {COLUMN: VALUE} (column names match the keys in returned rows, e.g. {"State": "TX"}).

filters.description: Optional exact-match column filters, e.g. {"State": "TX", "Provider_Type": "Hospital"}. Becomes filter[COLUMN]=VALUE.

keyword.description: Optional full-text search across all columns.

name: get_dataset
